spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(request_time, $__interval),
  path,
  AVG(request_duration_ms) AS avg_latency_ms
FROM request_metrics 
WHERE $__timeFilter(request_time)
GROUP BY 1, path
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Request Volume by HTTP Status Code

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('$__interval', request_time) AS time,
  TRIM(CAST(request_code AS TEXT)) AS metric, 
  COUNT(*) AS value 
FROM request_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(request_time)
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time
